-A.Name: -A
-A.description: Display the process audit user ID and other process audit properties, which requires privilege

-F.Name: -F
-F.description: Display the full name of the user

-G.Name: -G
-G.description: Display the different group IDs (effective, real and supplementary) as white-space separated numbers, in no particular order

-M.Name: -M
-M.description: Display the MAC label of the current process

-P.Name: -P
-P.description: Display the id as a password file entry

-g.Name: -g
-g.description: Display the effective group ID as a number

-n.Name: -n
-n.description: Display the name of the user or group ID for the -G, -g and -u options instead of the number.  If any of the ID numbers cannot be mapped into names the number will be displayed as usual

-u.Name: -u
-u.description: Display the effective user ID as a number
